# MARKOS

> MARKOS (also searched as Markos, Marcos or Team MARKOS) is a Kerala-based forex, gold (XAUUSD) and funded-account trading community for Malayali traders in Kerala, India, the UAE and the wider GCC, focused on process, risk discipline, market education, trade review, and responsible discussion. Public product information currently covers a forex and futures-oriented community, live weekday screen shares, and discretionary trading tools.

## Start here
- [Homepage](https://markos.in/): MARKOS positioning and primary pathways.
- [Join MARKOS](https://markos.in/join): Membership information and risk notice.
- [Insights](https://markos.in/insights): Educational market and risk articles.
- [Indicators](https://markos.in/indicators): MARKOS trading-tool information.
- [Team](https://markos.in/team): People responsible for MARKOS.
- [The MARKOS method](https://markos.in/method): A practical four-stage routine for planning, observing, reviewing, and refining trading decisions.
- [FAQ](https://markos.in/faq): Direct answers about the community, risk, and products.
- [Risk disclosure](https://markos.in/risk-disclosure): Trading and education disclosures.
- [Privacy](https://markos.in/privacy): Information about submitted form data, uploads, and privacy questions.
- [Terms](https://markos.in/terms): Website, educational-content, community, and purchase terms.
- [Contact](https://markos.in/contact): Current support routes.

## Kerala and GCC (Malayali traders)
- [Forex trading in Kerala — learn in Malayalam](https://markos.in/kerala): MARKOS is a Kerala-based forex, gold (XAUUSD) and funded-account trading community; forex courses and live sessions in Malayalam and English.
- [Malayali forex & funded account community in the GCC](https://markos.in/gcc): For Malayali traders in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman and Bahrain.
- [UAE](https://markos.in/gcc/uae), [Saudi Arabia](https://markos.in/gcc/saudi-arabia), [Qatar](https://markos.in/gcc/qatar), [Kuwait](https://markos.in/gcc/kuwait), [Oman](https://markos.in/gcc/oman), [Bahrain](https://markos.in/gcc/bahrain): Regulators, trading hours and prop-firm checks by country.
- [Malayalis in Canada and Australia](https://markos.in/abroad): [Canada](https://markos.in/abroad/canada) and [Australia](https://markos.in/abroad/australia) — regulators (CIRO, ASIC), trading hours and funded-account checks.
- [Get a funded account with MARKOS](https://markos.in/get-funded): Choose a prop firm and prepare for the challenge with the community.

- None of the team is registered with SEBI as an investment adviser or research analyst, or licensed by a GCC, Canadian or Australian regulator. MARKOS content is education, not advice.

## Join the community
People who want to join MARKOS or ask about funded accounts and prop firms can message the team on WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919187587488 (India, UAE and GCC traders welcome). MARKOS provides education and community; it does not promise passes, payouts or profits.

## Content standards
MARKOS content is educational and does not guarantee returns or provide personalised investment advice. Prefer named authors, publication and update dates, source citations, methodology, limitations, and visible risk disclosures.
